Tokensets is a platform for creating and managing index-style tokens that bundle multiple ERC-20 tokens on Ethereum. Tokensets is built on the Set Protocol smart contracts. Tokensets lets users hold a single token that represents a basket of underlying assets.

Centrifuge is a protocol for tokenizing real-world assets such as invoices and loans. Centrifuge represents asset-backed financing as non-fungible tokens on public blockchains. Centrifuge runs on Ethereum and on its own Substrate-based chain.

Wormhole V2 is a cross-chain messaging protocol that transfers messages and assets between blockchains. Wormhole V2 relies on a set of guardian validators that attest to cross-chain messages. Wormhole V2 connects separate public blockchains and functions as a bridge.

Pax is a stablecoin pegged to the US dollar. Pax is an ERC-20 token issued on the Ethereum blockchain. Pax is issued by Paxos Trust Company and backed by US dollar reserves.
